enrichment.summary: This amendment adds $4,400 to Integral Group's agreement for the Fremont High School new construction project, raising the limit from $313,925 to $318,325. The added work includes building envelope commissioning (testing that the building's outer shell performs as designed), reviewing requests for information and drawings for the adjacent library, and reviewing architect instructions about the breezeway expansion joint.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Gives Jensen Hughes three more months on Fruitvale Elementary's alarm project
enrichment.summary: This amendment extends the agreement with Jensen Hughes for services on the Fruitvale Elementary School fire and intrusion alarm replacement project by 92 days, from October 31, 2020 to January 31, 2021. It adds no money.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Awards Data Media Services $50,000 to install 11 cameras at Glenview Elementary
enrichment.summary: The district is awarding Data Media Services, Inc. a competitively bid contract to install eleven exterior cameras, including programming the servers and software, at Glenview Elementary School. Data Media was the lowest responsive and responsible bidder. The amount includes a $5,000 contingency. Work is scheduled to run 90 calendar days, from October 29, 2020 to January 27, 2021.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
